title: AutoTemplate
description: Canonical manifest.json file format for Project Auto templates — a self-contained bundle that includes a workflow definition, mock data, trigger sample data, and connections in a single file. This schema covers the template envelope only; the embedded workflow.definition payload is governed by the official Azure Logic Apps workflow definition schema declared in workflow.definition.$schema. This file is the cross-repo source of truth: this repo validates against it in CI, and the portal repo consumes the same file. Validation-only semantics: consumers are responsible for applying defaults.

mocks.description: Per-action mock outputs, keyed by action name.

notes.description: Sticky-note metadata copied from notes.json / notes-draft.json so templates round-trip the canvas annotations alongside mocks. Shape mirrors workflow.notes.

connections.description: Connection references keyed by connection name. Keys must use the _#workflowname# placeholder suffix.

category.description: One or more free-form category strings.

featuredConnectors.description: Connector ids surfaced on the template card, e.g. "/managedApis/sql" or "connectionProviders/request".

workflow.description: The bundled workflow: the definition only, with no wrapper metadata.

definition.description: Azure Logic Apps workflow definition. Its structure (triggers, actions, contentVersion, outputs, parameters, …) is governed by the official schema referenced in $schema — this envelope schema deliberately does not re-describe it. Note: the official 2016-06-01 schema predates Logic Apps Standard and agentic action types (Agent, ServiceProvider, ApiConnectionNotification), so validation against it is informational until Microsoft publishes an updated schema.

name.description: Trigger action name (must match a key in workflow.definition.triggers).

outputs.description: Sample outputs used to pre-fill the Test Draft editor.

templateMockOutput.description: Per-action mock entry. Two valid shapes: { runForReal: true } — explicit opt-out, the runtime executes the action live; or { status, outputs } (with runForReal absent or false) — the runtime uses the canned output instead of executing the action.

connectorType.description: Connection type: 'shared' for managed APIs, 'inapp' for built-in connectors, 'agent' for agent connections.

notes.description: Canvas sticky notes, keyed by note id.
